'''Vaela Blackcrest''' is the sharpest young historian of [[House Blackcrest]] — the perfected Blackcrest eye turned, her elders mutter, "the wrong way": toward ''what happened''.

Her first [[The Clean Page|Clean Page]] of record was the Harrowick granary fire of 396 A.U.: nine dead, two of them children, and a captain who died holding a door open for the last of the trapped. The entered version keeps the door and the dry wind; a realm-wide barrel ordinance followed, written in his honor. What the entered version keeps and what it drops is the house's craft — and, increasingly, her question. She asks questions phrased as statements — ''"It's strange that year 3 is empty"'' — and waits.
